observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: West spawn view is obstructed by oversized and intersecting geometry
observations.context: First source-frozen player-eye frame immediately after the two-player authoritative join
observations.action: Spawn and look forward without movement
observations.expectation: A safe pocket, readable first route, landmark, and unobstructed center-screen combat view
observations.actual: A cyan loop fills the upper-left foreground, multiple black members cut horizontally across the view, and nearby dressing intersects or crowds the camera and weapon.
observations.playerConsequence: The player cannot quickly parse a route or trust that visible geometry matches a deliberate arena layout.
reproduction: Join the Rev5 Inkfall profile with host and guest
hypotheses: Render-only continuity modules intrude into the west spawn camera envelope
One or more decorative modules have incorrect scale, transform, or containment placement
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Render a free-camera top, side, and player-eye overlay of the west spawn camera capsule against all 311 render-only continuity meshes.
observations.recommendedOutcome: Open a clean spawn sightline with one dominant route cue and no render mesh inside the player camera or weapon envelope.

observations.label: MEASURED
observations.title: Three of four player-eye views contain no readable arena geometry
observations.context: Press Hall, Ink Channel, and Archive camera orientations after an 11.63 m authoritative forward traversal
observations.action: Move forward for three seconds, then inspect three deliberately different pitch and yaw directions
observations.expectation: Distinct routes, landmarks, cover, vertical connections, and portal or objective cues
observations.actual: Frames 02 through 04 show nearly the same blue-gray gradient and lower-left light bloom, with no legible floor, walls, cover, portal, landmark, or route.
observations.playerConsequence: Navigation, combat prediction, spatial memory, and map acceptance are impossible from the available player-eye presentation.
reproduction: Advance from west spawn to x=-33500, y=50, z=8130
hypotheses: The camera is inside or immediately behind an oversized translucent or fog-like render surface
The render-only containment batch has incorrect transforms or camera-side culling
SwiftShader exposes a shader, depth, or material defect that must be separated from geometry placement
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Repeat the exact positions in visible hardware-accelerated Chrome and capture depth, material ID, and free-camera views before changing map art.
observations.recommendedOutcome: Every cardinal player-eye direction must expose a readable floor, boundary, route hierarchy, and at least one unique landmark under both hardware GPU and fallback rendering.

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: First-person presentation is still a blockout with no visible hands or arms
observations.context: All four normal combat HUD views with the rifle selected
observations.action: Observe the equipped rifle from the normal player camera
observations.expectation: Authored gloves and arms gripping a proportioned weapon with readable contact and muzzle origin
observations.actual: The rifle is composed of large rectangular masses, occupies a heavy lower-right silhouette, and has no visible hand, glove, forearm, or shoulder contact.
observations.playerConsequence: Weapon handling lacks physical ownership and the most persistent first-person surface reads as unfinished.
hypotheses: The runtime still binds a procedural or placeholder first-person rifle instead of the authored weapon-and-arms package
First-person arms are absent from the selected role loadout runtime binding
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Inspect the live first-person scene graph and capture muzzle, primary grip, support-hand, reload, swap, ADS, and recoil poses.
observations.recommendedOutcome: Ship one Assault first-person arms-and-rifle set with gloves, correct grips, muzzle alignment, authored silhouette, and full contact animation before propagating roles.

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: Lighting collapses into black crush and cyan-white bloom
observations.context: Spawn frame and three traversal orientations
observations.action: Scan foreground, midground, and background for depth and material separation
observations.expectation: Readable combat silhouettes, cover edges, floor continuity, and a coherent industrial material hierarchy
observations.actual: The spawn frame loses large structures into near-black, while subsequent frames are dominated by a flat blue-gray field and overbright circular bloom.
observations.playerConsequence: Depth, cover, traversability, and threat silhouettes cannot be read reliably.
reproduction: Open all four v2 screenshots at native 1440x900
Compare center-screen and peripheral luminance separation
hypotheses: Material exposure and emissive values are not calibrated to the runtime renderer
The player camera is sampling an unintended containment or fog surface
Fallback WebGL rendering differs materially from the intended hardware path
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Capture the same four poses with material overrides, no post-processing, and hardware acceleration to isolate geometry, material, and renderer causes.
observations.recommendedOutcome: Establish a restrained value hierarchy where floors, cover, players, portals, and exits remain readable without crushing dark materials or blooming emissives.

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: Developer diagnostics remain exposed and compete with the match HUD
observations.action: Read match state, health, ammo, abilities, and threat space
observations.expectation: A restrained competitive HUD with diagnostics hidden behind an explicit drawer
observations.actual: A multi-row Diagnostics and authority-event panel is permanently visible at upper right beside pre-release mode labels, while multiple typography sizes and boxed ability elements compete around the frame.
observations.playerConsequence: The screen reads as an internal test harness rather than one coherent competitive game and reduces peripheral clarity.
reproduction: Do not open a developer panel
Observe the always-visible upper-right diagnostics block
hypotheses: Evidence diagnostics are mounted by default on the normal product route
Legacy and newer HUD surfaces are both active
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Inspect the default online HUD view model and verify diagnostics are absent until an explicit developer command opens them.
observations.recommendedOutcome: Hide diagnostics by default, unify match typography and spacing, preserve center-screen clearance, and expose technical state only in a deliberate developer drawer.

observations.label: UNKNOWN
observations.title: Opponent presentation cannot be assessed from the current packet
observations.context: Two authoritative player contexts were joined, but no opponent is visible in any of the four source-frozen frames
observations.action: Attempt to inspect enemy silhouette, armor, helmet, weapon contact, and locomotion
observations.expectation: Controlled near, mid, and far views of the live opponent package
observations.actual: The evidence proves one remote avatar existed in runtime but supplies no visible player-eye opponent frame or motion sequence.
observations.playerConsequence: Enemy model, role readability, animation, hit response, and weapon-contact acceptance remain unproven.
reproduction: Inspect all four screenshots for the remote avatar
hypotheses: The fixed visual route never placed the guest inside the host camera frustum
Map obstruction prevents the remote avatar from being seen
The remote runtime model may be present but still use a placeholder package
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Stage the two players at fixed 5 m, 20 m, and 40 m separations and capture front, rear, strafe, jump, fire, reload, hit, death, and respawn sequences.
observations.recommendedOutcome: Provide a controlled live opponent acceptance reel before any third-person or role-family visual claim.
